feeding_claim.verbatim: Our cows are 100% grass-fed and grass-finished.

notes: Central Illinois farm started in Stelle in 1992, now farming about 220 certified-organic acres. The cattle are 100% grass-fed and grass-finished. The farm also raises sheep, goats, pigs, turkeys and chickens and sells eggs; sheep and goats get an organic fermented soy fiber supplement and the pigs, chickens and turkeys forage pasture plus organic grains, so only the beef is grass-finished. Sells through an online shop, farmers markets, a Chicago-area meat CSA and Wednesday home delivery in the Chicago area, and says it can ship anywhere in the United States. The site describes certified-organic pastures; organic labels are left to the USDA matching script rather than added by hand.
